Quick tech checklist for the working session and load window: 

- Routing: we'll demo latency-first routing to the hosted endpoint, then show cost-aware fallback to a quantized variant. Please flag any prompts that must always hit the high-accuracy variant.
- Token budget: for the simulated load window (30m burst + 30m steady) plan for ~150k tokens total. If you expect longer golden responses, increase by ~30%.
- Load test data: we need a CSV with columns: id, prompt, context (optional), expected_gold. Keep prompts short for spike tests; include one longer dialogue per 10 items for stateful KV cache checks.
- Preflight: we'll run a quick redaction verification against the sample set before the session (no raw persistence). If we detect structured PII, we'll flag rows for mask/replacement and share a sanitized copy.

Presigned upload link (expires 72h): https://s3-presign.example.com/acme-onramp-upload

I'll attach a short routing-and-load-notes.md to the calendar invite.
